unit.explanation: One patient-derived rectal cancer organoid line per LARC patient (P81-P128 / O81-O128); validation-cohort denominator is 48 patients.

platform.explanation: Patient-derived rectal cancer organoid (RCO) lines treated ex vivo with irradiation, 5-Fu and CPT-11 (Table S2 = ratios of RCO size change).

readout.explanation: Table S2 reports ratios of RCO size change on day 24 to day 0 after single treatments and combined chemoradiation (organoid survival/size readout).

direction.explanation: Size recovery ratio <= 34.87% defines an organoid line sensitive to combined chemoradiation; > 34.87% defines resistance.

threshold_rule.explanation: Cutoff 34.87% (95% CI 34.30-40.14) is the mean optimal cutoff from Youden's index with bootstrap sampling.

threshold_timing.explanation: The 34.87% cutoff was optimized on discovery-cohort organoids O1-O80 and applied unchanged to the held-out validation cohort O81-O128.

patient_mapping.explanation: Table S1 gives per-patient TRG/cCR and Table S2 gives per-patient organoid size ratios; P and O numbers correspond one-to-one.

regimen_match.explanation: Organoid combined chemoradiation (8 Gy + 5-Fu 10 uM + CPT-11 10 uM) matches the 39 validation patients on radiation/irinotecan/capecitabine, but 8 received radiation/capecitabine only and 1 irinotecan/capecitabine without radiation.

n_units.explanation: Table S5 total for the validation-cohort diagnostic test is 48 patients (20 organoid-sensitive + 28 organoid-resistant).

split.explanation: P81-P128 form a held-out validation cohort distinct from the P1-P80 discovery cohort used to derive the cutoff.

notes: Raw per-patient scores are the Table S2 combined-chemoradiation day24/day0 RCO size ratios for validation patients P81-P128; the headline cutoff 0.3487 (<= cutoff = organoid sensitive = predicted good responder) binarizes them.
Truth is the Table S1 clinical outcome mapped as TRG 0/1 or cCR = good (1) and TRG 2/3 = poor (0), per article:p72.
Agreement is 45/48 = 0.9375, matching Table S5 'Accuracy(%)=(19+26)/(20+28)=93.75%' (supp.pdf/page15/R31C1) and the text (93.75% accuracy, 96.30% sensitivity, 90.48% specificity).

The three discordant cases are exactly those named in the text: P104 (ratio 0.3454, organoid-sensitive but pTRG 2), P105 (ratio 0.6035, organoid-resistant but cCR) and P124 (ratio 0.4641, organoid-resistant but pTRG 0).
Organoid assay labels (sensitive/resistant) are kept distinct from patient clinical outcomes (TRG/cCR); accuracy is patient-level concordance, not an assay replicate statistic.
